notes.subject: Edom denmuso
notes.rationale: Lajɛbali ye Edom denmuso ye — kuma tilennen bɛ a kan.

notes.subject: i diya, i kɛ lafiya
notes.rationale: Dambiliw ye — nka u ye ɲɔgɔnya-ka-bɔ ye, a tɛ lafiya tiɲɛ ye.

notes.subject: ותתערי
notes.rationale: KJV/ASV fɔ 'i bɛna bɔ i yɛrɛ la a fɔ (nakedness)'; Geneva fɔ 'i bɛna ɲɔgɔn-wɔrɔ (vomit)' — Hebri daɲɛ ka kɔrɔ ta 'ka ɲɛfɔ i yɛrɛ kan / ka bɔ a fɔ'.

notes.subject: kuru
notes.rationale: כוס ye kuru ye, nka a bɛ Kuma-w cogo na — Yawe ka sanga-kuru min bɛ tɛmɛ jamana na.

translation: I diya ani i kɛ lafiya, Edom denmuso, min bɛ sigida Uts (Usi) dugukolo la. Kuru fana bɛ tɛmɛ i la: i bɛna mini, ka bɔ i yɛrɛ la a fɔ.

tokens.gloss: ka bɔ i yɛrɛ la a fɔ
